steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Choose a phrase because it matches your meaning. Note one phrase, adapt its details to your own life, close your notes and say it in a different scene.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.
